ValidationRule.description: Enforce contact on general queries when put on hold customer if there's no web email.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: NOT($Permission.SC_BypassValidationRules) && (RecordType.DeveloperName = "General_Queries" || RecordType.DeveloperName = "Account_Management") && ISCHANGED(Status) && ISPICKVAL(Status, "On Hold - Customer") && ISBLANK(ContactId) && ISBLANK(SuppliedEmail)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please add a Contact or Web Email before putting the case status on "On Hold - Customer".
